[EVENT] User is thinking of doing a hike with friends soon.  
[RELATIONSHIP] One of the friends is a total newbie to hiking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for someone who's never been hiking before, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Discuss expectations about the hike's length, difficulty, and terrain.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Choose a suitable trail with gentle incline and minimal obstacles (3-5 miles).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Advise on dress code: comfortable clothing, sturdy shoes, and dressing in layers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Pack essentials: water, snacks, sunscreen, hat, and first-aid kit.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] During the hike, start slow, stay hydrated, take breaks, watch for hazards, and encourage communication.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include bringing a map and compass, being prepared for weather, respecting the environment, staying together, and having fun.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Post-hike tips include debriefing and discussing the experience and encouraging stretching and recovery.
